entities.name: Małgorzata Tkacz-Janik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Małgorzata Tkacz-Janik is a Polish feminist activist and politician. Together with Dariusz Szwed she led Poland's green party Greens 2004 between 2010 and 2011. Since November 2010 she has been a member of the regional parliament of Silesia.
